title: The Visitor of the Undercroft
author: Kestrel Zhou
blurb: Ivo Zhou, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
